title: Prevent Settings save fetch regressions
summary: Harden Local API and WebView Settings tests so Tauri-origin fetch failures and brittle Settings save smoke assertions are caught before release.
reason: Settings save and backend snapshot reads previously failed as browser fetch errors when actual Local API responses lacked authorized CORS headers. The test suite also pinned volatile Settings copy instead of durable save-route behavior.
behavior_before: Coverage checked OPTIONS CORS and some Settings static text, but did not verify actual Tauri-origin responses for snapshot/workspace/save or browser-rendered save evidence.
behavior_after: Coverage verifies actual Tauri-origin API responses for health, snapshot, settings workspace, and settings save; Settings smokes assert durable backend-owned save behavior instead of fragile copy.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m pytest tests/webview/test_webview_browser_settings_builder_flush_smoke.py -q - passed with LocalApiServer shell_surface=tauri and injected MEDIA_PIPELINE_TAURI_BOOTSTRAP token (1 passed)

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed: unrelated uncovered files ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserProseBoxAudit.ps1 and tests/webview/test_webview_browser_prose_box_audit.py
rollback_plan: Revert the test/smoke hardening and this packet. The Local API CORS implementation remains unchanged, but future regressions would be less likely to be caught by targeted tests.
notes:
Implement prevention plan for Tauri-origin Settings save fetch regressions.
Strict coverage failure is unrelated to this Settings save regression work; uncovered prose-box audit files were not absorbed into this packet.
Browser Settings smoke now starts the temporary Local API in Tauri surface mode and injects MEDIA_PIPELINE_TAURI_BOOTSTRAP before page scripts execute.
